references.title: Understanding Simpson's Paradox
references.author: Judea Pearl
references.retrieval: PDF retrieved; sections 1, 2.1, 2.3 and mediator/common-cause discussion inspected
references.paraphrase: The paper distinguishes arithmetic association reversal from causal interpretation. Causal structure can determine whether conditioning is appropriate; a grouping variable can block a causal pathway. This supports the course's limited caution that grouping and common weights alone do not establish an intervention effect.
